content.value: A thin flat plate is installed in a water tunnel as a splitter. The plate is 0. 3 m long and 1 m wide. The free-stream speed is 1.6 rn/sec. Assume laminar boundary layers form on both sides of the plate and the velocity profile is approximated as parabolic. Determine the total drag on the plate. Assume p = 1000 kg/m3 and $\mu = 1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 3 }$ Pa.s.
S(a) Explain the terms with significance: drag coefficient and lift coefficient for external viscous flows.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
